# Entrain Culinary Academy

> Entrain Culinary Academy (also called Entrain Academy) is a practical, chef-led culinary school in Manjeri, Kerala, India. It offers hands-on one-day and one-week workshops, bakery training and food business training for aspiring food entrepreneurs, hospitality professionals and career seekers. It is part of Entrain EduHub, and every course includes a certificate.

Key facts:
- Location: Veemboor - Mariyad School Rd, Manjeri, Kerala 676122, India
- Phone: +91 75938 41013
- Founder: Noufal K Keedath (family bakery since 2014, Cobolt Machinery commercial kitchen equipment since 2020, Entrain Academy since 2025)
- Instructors: chefs with 20-25 years of commercial industry experience, including Chef Akhil (Continental, South Indian, American cuisine) and Chef Sharafali (Arabic cuisine)
- Format: hands-on training on commercial kitchen equipment, multilingual classes
- Food and accommodation are included with selected intensive programs (e.g. the one-week and five-day courses); confirm current arrangements with the academy before enrolling
- Career assistance and job guidance are offered, but placement is not guaranteed
- Learners come from across India (including Karnataka, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Delhi, Goa and more) and from South Africa and Tanzania
- Who it serves: existing food business owners, people planning to start a food business, restaurant and hospitality professionals, job seekers in hospitality, candidates preparing for overseas employment, and agency-referred groups

## One-week and intensive programs

- [Master 1-Week Course](https://www.entrainculinaryschool.com/courses/master-one-week-course): Intensive program covering eight commercial fast-food essentials
- [Shawarma & Shawai Course](https://www.entrainculinaryschool.com/courses/shawarma-shawai): 5-day hands-on program covering four shawarma styles and three shawai styles
- [Bakery & Pastry Diploma](https://www.entrainculinaryschool.com/courses/bakery-pastry-diploma): Bakery and pastry training program
- [Arabian Cuisine Masterclass](https://www.entrainculinaryschool.com/courses/arabian-cuisine-masterclass): Arabian cuisine training

## One-day workshops

- [Dessert Workshop](https://www.entrainculinaryschool.com/courses/dessert-workshop): Dessert jars, tiramisu and Middle Eastern fusion desserts
- [Fried Chicken Masterclass](https://www.entrainculinaryschool.com/courses/fried-chicken-masterclass): Coating, frying, sauces and business insight
- [Loaded Fries & Mojito Workshop](https://www.entrainculinaryschool.com/courses/loaded-fries-mojito-workshop): Loaded fries and mojito preparation
- [Pizza & Burger Workshop](https://www.entrainculinaryschool.com/courses/pizza-burger-workshop): Pizza and burger preparation for food businesses
